io.github.sefiraat.networks.utils.datatypes

Class PersistentCardInstanceType

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.sefiraat.networks.utils.datatypes.PersistentCardInstanceType

  • public final class PersistentCardInstanceType
extends java.lang.Object
    Version-safe persistence for CardInstance (item + amount + limit).

    Stores flat String-keyed values through PersistentDataAPI instead of a nested PersistentDataContainer, so it never references org.bukkit.persistence.* in bytecode.
